feedback: The geometry changes so far have improved noise robustness and turning stability by increasing sensor size to 0.016 and wheel track to 0.16, and moving sensors forward by +0.01 in y. However, the telemetry shows that line loss events still occur once per run on both oval and s-bend tracks, causing off-track terminations. The controller had to compensate for delayed line detection and resulting steering oscillations. The incremental forward shift of +0.005 in sensor y-positions is a reasonable fine-tuning step to improve early line detection and control anticipation without destabilizing sensor weighting. This should help reduce line loss events and improve control smoothness and completion rates. Requested changes: 1) Try sensor_positions y-values shifted forward by +0.005 from the current iteration (i.e., y = 0.055, 0.035, 0.015, 0.035, 0.055). 2) Retain sensor_size at 0.016 to maintain noise robustness. 3) Retain wheel_track at 0.16 for turning stability. These changes are expected to improve line anticipation and reduce steering oscillations, as supported by the telemetry evidence.
requested_changes: sensor_positions y-values shifted forward by +0.005 from current iteration
